subject: geography
field: Leaving Certificate Geography (current syllabus, first examined 2006)
note: One paper per level. Part One is 12 short questions (answer 10) covering OS maps, aerial photographs, weather charts, graphs/tables and general topics — tag each short question to the chapter its content belongs to, not to a catch-all. Part Two Section 1 is physical geography, Section 2 is regional geography, Section 3 is the two electives (Economic Activities Q7-Q9, Human Environment Q10-Q12), and Section 4 is the Higher-Level-only options (Q13-Q18). Ordinary Level papers have no Section 4. Tag by the topic actually examined; a question that asks for a case study still belongs to the topic chapter, not to a 'case study' chapter.
